verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's docs say you can create API credentials under Settings > API Accounts "with the scopes you need" (docs-32), so a narrowly scoped credential can be issued for an agent. They also describe OAuth-based store-, app-, and account-level API accounts (docs-39). missing for 10: detail on how fine-grained the scopes are (e.g. read-only vs modify per resource), credential expiry/rotation/revocation controls, any agent-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
